# Custom instructions for Copilot

## Plotting
- Plot using seaborn.
- Always end plots with sns.despine().
- Default seaborn context should be talk. 
- Use seaborn colorblind palette.
- Dpi 300.

### Histograms
- If there are multiple histograms on same axis, make bins consistent.
- Do not plot kde. 

## General coding style
- Prefer concise variable names and comments.
- Don't save intermediates as variables unless I may use again.
